participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Reflective and somewhat cynical, she often thinks about the past and her ambitions. She has a creative side but feels it has been overshadowed by her current life.
participant_1.background: i have two grown children who never visit. i fantasize about taking over the world. i am a 56 year old woman. i used to be a painter but now i'm a housekeeper. i used to be pretty but time has not been kind.

participant_2.name: Emily
participant_2.personality: Creative and optimistic, she loves art and expresses herself through drawing and painting. She has a sunny disposition and enjoys sharing her passions.
participant_2.background: i like to take walks. i live in a house. i like to eat hamburgers and french fries. i don't drink soda.
